title: Good access to the crack and integrability of the full gradient for Griffith almost-minimizers in the plane
summary: We show that, for almost-minimizers of the Griffith energy in the plane, the complement of the crack is locally covered by a finite number of John domains where the displacement satisfies Hölder-type estimates. As a consequence, we derive the integrability of the full gradient and the finiteness of the traces along the crack. In particular, we show that any Griffith almost-minimizer in dimension two locally belongs to the space SBV^2.
